name: nuclei
label: nuclei
description: ProjectDiscovery nuclei with pinned templates (HTTP only; known CVEs, misconfigurations, exposed files, technologies, takeovers): reports each match as a vulnerability, or a technology, under the URL it matched at.
contacts: about 11,000 HTTP requests to {target}'s host for known CVEs, misconfigurations and exposed files (at most 5 a second, up to 55 minutes); no intrusive, fuzzing or brute-force templates; no out-of-band callbacks; redirects are not followed
